data_fields.name: lodCentreOffset
data_fields.donor_constant: one chunk unit on the approach side (delay)

best_idea: Cap per-frame work by counting accepted draws and uploads (not list positions) and sort nearest first so the cap drops the far work.
decision_why: The idea (interest box, camera-relative culling, nearest-first buckets, async build with in-flight de-duplication, an upload budget) fits a phone build; the donor's caps count list slots, the animated count is off by one and uploads are uncapped, and the sketch fixes all three.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone walking into a dense zone, no frame exceeds the upload budget, the nearest chunks finish first, and a unit test shows the cutout and shadow caps count drawn items and exactly maxAnimated visible chunks are animated.
